audit_items.proof_trace: `deposit_underlying` atomically executes `self.cash = self.cash + coin.value()` and joins the coin into the underlying balance (L302-303); Move's linear type system ensures the same `Coin<CoinType>` object is passed unmodified from `deposit()` → `handle_mint()` → `mint_ctokens()` → `deposit_underlying()`. `accrue_interest` called in `handle_mint` (L274) only mutates `self.debt`, `self.cash_reserve`, and `borrow_index`, not `self.cash`, so no other mutation of `self.cash` occurs during the deposit transaction.
